# 錄外經等目錄

**Volume:** T55

**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T2175

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-juan **anonymous Heian-era Japanese supplementary catalog** of canonical sutras and other materials **not included in the principal canonical bibliographies** (*lùwài* 錄外, "outside-the-catalog"). Preserved at T55 no. 2175. *notBefore* = **800**, *notAfter* = **1000** (broadly the Heian-era bracket). Catalog dynasty 日本.

The work documents materials acquired through *nittō hakke* importations or other channels but not formally entered into the standard Heian canonical-bibliographic apparatus. As a supplementary catalog, it is a primary witness to the **breadth of Heian-era Japanese Buddhist textual holdings beyond the canonical core**.
